title: STILL PRESENT (r2): wrong-person route's taken-over stand-down is read-time only — a take-over racing the wrong-person POST still yanks a landlord-handled row into awaiting_correction
evidence: form_handler.gleam: 'case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) False -> ... sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)' ; update_reference_call_status.sql: 'WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status' (no taken_over_at filter)
detail: Take-over writes only taken_over_at, leaving status contact_initiated, so the guarded UPDATE matches and flips a just-taken-over row to awaiting_correction. Sweep excludes it, complete_reference_call requires contact_initiated, panel hides menu on taken-over rows — dead-end, the r2 blocker invariant. mark_awaiting_correction got the write-time guard; this leg did not.
recommended_fix: Add 'AND taken_over_at IS NULL' to update_reference_call_status.sql (or a dedicated wrong-person query mirroring mark_awaiting_correction.sql) so the write re-checks what the read checked.

title: sweep_terminal / sweep_mark_failed lack the taken_over_at write guard — a take-over racing the T+144h terminalization lands on a taken-over row and kills the §8.6 live form link
evidence: sweep_terminal.sql: 'WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'contact_initiated' AND attempt_count = 4' — no taken_over_at filter; sweep_mark_failed.sql: 'WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('queued', 'contact_initiated')' — no taken_over_at filter; every other sweep write (sweep_claim_t0, sweep_advance) carries 'AND taken_over_at IS NULL'
detail: The sweep SELECT excludes taken-over rows but the terminal UPDATE re-checks only status/attempt_count. A take-over committing between SELECT and UPDATE terminalizes the just-taken-over row (partial/unreachable), so the §7.7 'form link stays live' / §8.6 late-completion promise dies; partial+taken_over is unrecoverable.
recommended_fix: Add 'AND taken_over_at IS NULL' to sweep_terminal.sql and sweep_mark_failed.sql, matching sweep_claim_t0/sweep_advance; a 0-row result stands down the tick.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2 N5): single-slot refcheck_edit — opening a second row's substitute/correct edit or any action success still silently discards another row's in-progress typed trio
evidence: 'RefcheckSubstitute -> #( Model(..menu_closed, refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(model, call_id, RefcheckEditSubstitute))), effect.none() )' ; Ok arm: 'let cleared = Model(..model, refcheck_edit: None, refcheck_confirm: None, ...)'
detail: The behind-a-button + closing-Cancel halves of r2 N5 are fixed, but the overwrite path is unchanged: choosing substitute/correct on another row (or any action's success) unconditionally replaces/clears the open edit, discarding unsaved typed values with no guard or prompt.
recommended_fix: Preserve an open edit for a different call_id (only overwrite when the new choice targets the same row), or confirm discarding unsaved trio values before replacing.

title: STILL PRESENT (r2 N14, partial): Escape closes the menu only when focus is inside the menu — after clicking ⋯ (focus stays on the trigger) Escape leaves the menu open
evidence: 'event.on( "keydown", menu_escape_decoder(msg.UserToggledRefcheckMenu(call.reference_call_id)) )' attached to the menu div (a sibling of the ⋯ button); no autofocus moves focus into the menu on open (confirm_modal uses attribute.autofocus(True))
detail: Keydown bubbles from the focused ⋯ button through its ancestors, never through the sibling menu div, so the handler fires only once focus is on a menuitem. The natural click-⋯-then-Escape flow does nothing.
recommended_fix: Attach the Escape decoder to the row container/relative wrapper (an ancestor of the trigger), or autofocus the first menuitem on open like confirm_modal.

title: AppCompletedRefcheckExport toasts unconditionally — a clipboard result settling after navigation lands 'Attempt log copied' on an unrelated page
evidence: 'AppCompletedRefcheckExport(_call_id, result) -> case result { Ok(_) -> add_toast(Model(..model, clipboard_copied: None), copy.refcheck_toast_exported, ToastSuccess) ...' — no route/call-presence guard (the r2 W3 fix guards only ApiReturnedRefcheckAction)
detail: The export click copies via a promise; if the landlord navigates before it settles, the success/failure toast fires on the new page — the same stale-toast class r2 W3 fixed for row actions, unguarded for the export leg.
recommended_fix: Route the export response through refcheck_response_is_current (or clear clipboard_copied on route change) so stale results drop silently.
